# Denz — Coworking Café in Phuket, Thailand

> Denz is a modern coworking café in Kathu, Phuket, Thailand. We offer flexible hot desk and dedicated desk coworking, private offices, hotel-style accommodation rooms, a full café menu with Thai and international food, and equipment rentals — all in one place.

## Key information
- Location: Kathu, Pa Tong, Phuket 83120, Thailand
- WiFi: 1 Gbps fibre, included with all packages
- Open: Monday – Friday (coworking), daily (café and rooms)
- Contact: @denzphuket on Instagram and Facebook

## Pages
- Home: https://denzphuket.com/
- Coworking: https://denzphuket.com/coworking
- Rooms: https://denzphuket.com/rooms
- Café Menu: https://denzphuket.com/menu
- Contact: https://denzphuket.com/contact

## Coworking
Flexible desk coworking in Phuket. Hourly from ฿50, daily, weekly, and monthly packages available. Dedicated desks let you leave your belongings and keep the same spot throughout your booking. Hot desks are walk-in, first-come first-served. Private offices also available for teams.

## Rooms
Accommodation rooms on-site. Standard, Deluxe, and Studio Suite options. Direct access to the coworking café. Gigabit WiFi in every room. Mountain views.

## Amenities
1 Gbps fibre WiFi · Free coffee and tea · Printing · Lockers · Standing desks · Community · Mountain views · Air conditioning · On-site café and kitchen
